Optimizer.description: The optimization scheme to improve the quality of the DOE after sampling.
Optimizer.title: Optimizer

description: The settings for the LHS DOE from the SciPy library.

callbacks.description:
The functions called after evaluating the function of interest.

A callback must be called as ``callback(sample_index, (output, Jacobian))``.
callbacks.title: Callbacks

enable_progress_bar.description:
Whether to enable the progress bar in the optimization log.

If ``None``, use the global value of ``enable_progress_bar`` (see the
``configure`` function to change it globally).
enable_progress_bar.title: Enable Progress Bar

eq_tolerance.description: The tolerance on the equality constraints.
eq_tolerance.title: Eq Tolerance

eval_func.description: Whether to sample the function computing the output values.
eval_func.title: Eval Func

eval_jac.description: Whether to sample the function computing the Jacobian data.
eval_jac.title: Eval Jac

ineq_tolerance.description: The tolerance on the inequality constraints.
ineq_tolerance.title: Ineq Tolerance

log_problem.description: Whether to log the definition and result of the problem.
log_problem.title: Log Problem

max_time.description: The maximum runtime in seconds, disabled if 0.
max_time.title: Max Time

n_processes.description: The maximum number of processes to parallelize the execution.
n_processes.title: N Processes

normalize_design_space.description: Whether to normalize the design space variables between 0 and 1.
normalize_design_space.title: Normalize Design Space

optimization.description:
The name of an optimization scheme to improve the DOE's quality.

If ``None``, use the DOE as is. New in SciPy 1.10.0.

preprocessors.description:
The functions called
before evaluating the function of interest.

A preprocessor must be called as ``preprocessor(sample_index)``.

This option is not compatible with the vectorization of functions evaluations.
preprocessors.title: Preprocessors

progress_bar_data_name.description:
The name of a :class:`.BaseProgressBarData` class
to define the data of an evaluation problem to be displayed in the progress bar.

reset_iteration_counters.description: Whether to reset the iteration counters before each execution.
reset_iteration_counters.title: Reset Iteration Counters

round_ints.description: Whether to round the integer variables.
round_ints.title: Round Ints

scramble.description:
Whether to use scrambling (Owen type).

Only available with SciPy >= 1.10.0.
scramble.title: Scramble

seed.description:
The seed used for reproducibility reasons.

If ``None``, use :attr:`.seed`.
seed.title: Seed

store_jacobian.description:
Whether to store the Jacobian matrices in the database.

    This argument is ignored when the ``use_database`` option is ``False``.
    If a gradient-based algorithm is used,
    this option cannot be set along with kkt options.
store_jacobian.title: Store Jacobian

use_database.description: Whether to wrap the functions in the database.
use_database.title: Use Database

use_one_line_progress_bar.description: Whether to log the progress bar on a single line.
use_one_line_progress_bar.title: Use One Line Progress Bar

vectorize.description: Whether to vectorize the functions evaluations.
vectorize.title: Vectorize

wait_time_between_samples.description: The time to wait between each sample evaluation, in seconds.
wait_time_between_samples.title: Wait Time Between Samples

title: LHS_Settings
